verdict.rationale: TaxJar provides transaction-level data via API (order creation, product_tax_code, address validation) and pricing tier mentions an 'archive of historical sales tax data,' suggesting stored transaction records are retained and retrievable. However, there is no explicit evidence of a detailed audit trail showing the specific rate, rule, and address-resolution logic used per transaction, nor documented export functionality for audit purposes. missing for 10: explicit audit-trail/report showing rate+rule+address+category breakdown per transaction, documented export/reporting tool for auditors, retention period details, independent verification of reconstructability.
